items.text: Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (ribs), making it unlikely he plays Sunday vs Raiders.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs post hard fall; ribs limiting.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; WR depth chart opens.
items.opportunity: Tre Harris primary beneficiary; Quentin Johnston boosted.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP second straight Thursday; Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) on IR. If Flowers OUT, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.implication: Flowers flex risk; Bateman becomes preferred start.
items.opportunity: Target/route share jumps for Bateman if Flowers sits.

items.text: Nico Collins injured hamstring at Wednesday practice; doctors don't believe serious (Grade 1 strain per reports) but DNP Thursday and Week 2 status vs Bengals in jeopardy. Missed 5 games on prior hammy in 2024.
items.why: Hamstring strain history + consecutive limited/DNP; MRI/tests confirm low grade but timing tight.
items.implication: High-end WR2 risk; monitor Friday practice. If OUT, boosts Boutte/Hutchinson/Noel/Schultz.
items.opportunity: Routes: Collins 37/42 last week; backups see volume spike.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson says 'I'm ready to go' after ankle; unclear how much he eats into Rhamondre Stevenson but timing ideal with AJ Brown IR and soft upcoming schedule (PIT/JAX/BUF etc before bye).
items.why: Full practice/ready comments; Pats need explosives.
items.opportunity: Explosive plays + matchups favor shared or lead role.

items.text: Brock Bowers DNP again Thursday due to last week's knee surgery; has yet to practice since.
items.implication: TE1 risk; Mayer or others elevate if inactive.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 24% target share (tied lead) in Chiefs debut, 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted. Indy gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall in range of outcomes.
items.why: Elite utilization + soft matchup; 10 Facts notes career-high-ish share.
items.opportunity: 24% tgt + high snap/touch share; goal-line implied.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE: Matched Miller rushes W1, 69% pts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role; NO underdogs vs BAL not run-script friendly.
items.implication: Sit/fade; Miller reverse beneficiary if Kamara limited.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: Utilization Score 99 (tied Bijan lead) in Kubiak debut; 19% tgt share last 10; 25+ touches in 3/4 recent. Overreaction to injury scare.
items.why: Near-max util + consistent volume under new OC.

items.text: ETR W2 waivers injury beneficiaries: McConkey=Tre Harris; Lane=Bateman/Moore; AJ Brown=Doubs/Douglas; Stribling=Deebo/Robinson; Kamara=Miller (reverse); Murray=Wentz; plus Vele, Sadiq etc. Top adds: Wentz, Black, Miller, Deebo.
items.implication: Prioritize injury fills and streamers like Wentz.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE (bounceback): 27% tgt share + 13.7 aDOT (3 deep) W1. TEN allowed 85% catch/16 YPR to Jets WRs; 6th-most PPG to WRs.
items.opportunity: Target share + aDOT vs vulnerable D.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: Career-high 26% tgt share, out-routed Gainwell by 8, all RB RZ touches in W1. CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
items.why: Passing-down + RZ dominance vs soft run D.

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE: 37% tgt share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career avg with Wentz. Bears D allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
items.why: Elite share + proven chemistry vs soft matchup.
items.implication: WR1 lock even with Murray uncertainty.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr HATE: 8% tgt share W1 (5th on team), zero RZ. SEA 3rd-fewest PPG to WRs.
items.why: Anemic targets + tough matchup + Bourne competition.
items.implication: Sit; prefer other ARI options or waivers.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid LOVE: 69% route participation (career high vs last yr), 77% snaps (highest since 2024 W9), top-5 TE util. DET allowed 27 to TEs.
